prompts.prompt: Create a 12-frame chest-opening pixel art sprite sheet using the attached screenshot as the authoritative EXACT character/object design reference. Preserve the current game chest: warm dark brown wooden planks, BLACK/DARK IRON reinforced bands with small gold rivets, gold central diamond-shaped latch/escutcheon, arched wood lid, golden coins and colorful small gems inside, warm GOLDEN treasure sparkle. No blue chest, no icy metal, no blue crystals. Reference screenshot shows the open chest; extrapolate a mechanically coherent closed lid of the SAME chest. Same slightly top-down front camera, proportions and compact richly shaded pixel-art rendering as screenshot. Remove dungeon floor/background and crop selection yellow lines entirely. Genuine transparent background. Sheet 4 columns x3 rows,12 equally spaced poses read left to right top to bottom. Frame1 closed,2 closed slight anticipation,3 latch tiny golden glint,4 lid cracked 10degrees,5 lid25degrees,6 lid45degrees,7 lid65degrees,8 lid85degrees revealing gold treasure,9 fully open matching screenshot,10 lid settles slightly,11 stable open with gold twinkle,12 stable open dimmer twinkle. All frames share identical chest base width, body geometry, foot baseline within cells, orientation, scale and pivot; only rear-hinged lid moves. No frame numbers or labels. No surrounding floor, no characters, no loose loot flying outside chest. Coins and gems inside but no giant treasure explosion. Crisp compact pixel clusters, no airbrushed gradients, no cinematic lighting. Generous transparent gutters and padding, fully raised lid entirely inside frame. 1536x1152 requested. Match warm gold treasure and brown/iron chest faithfully, not the prior blue redesign.

Pixel-art game VFX source sprite atlas, true transparent background. 6 columns by 5 rows, 30 isolated effects, generous gutters, consistent center/pivot every cell, no text or grid. Five rarity glows for dropped equipment on a dark fantasy dungeon floor, matching compact crisp pixel chest graphics. Each row is 6 chronological frames of a gentle seamless idle pulse: faint, medium, bright, medium, faint, returning medium. Row1 COMMON silver gray RGB166176184: restrained small scattered glints and faint flat pool. Row2 UNCOMMON green RGB77224135: short green glow with 2 rising motes. Row3 RARE blue RGB77158255: blue light pool with short upward light rays and 3 motes. Row4 EPIC violet RGB20497255: violet pool with taller thin pixel rays and 4 motes. Row5 LEGENDARY amber orange RGB25515341: bright amber pool with warm gold vertical rays and diamond sparkles. All glows must leave center readable for a separate loot item overlaid in game. Effects ONLY, no chest, no weapons/items, no circular warning outlines, no runic circles, no labels, no floor/background or colored matte. Glow represented by discrete pixel clusters and alpha falloff, keep crisp retro look rather than airbrush. Rows use same floor anchor with increasing rarity prominence without filling the screen. 1536x1280 requested.
